citations.assessment: The linked notice uses Minyamin and states the synchronism with Rav. The current article queries it. Preserve the different name spellings, competing voices and disputed chronology.
The primary passage expressly names Minyomi bar Ḥilkiyah alongside Rav Ḥilkiyah bar Tovya and Rav Huna bar Ḥiyya. It does not establish the identity of the two Ḥilkiyahs.
The digital witness names R. Minyomi bar Ḥilkiyah reporting R. Maḥseya bar Idi in Yoḥanan’s name.
The parallel on this folio uses Rav where 3b has R. in the Minyomi attribution. Keep Heilprin’s scribal-error assessment as his wording.
The Bavli has Minyomi transmitting Ḥama bar Gurya in Rav’s name, followed by a separately printed Minyamin bar Ḥilkiyah giving his own ruling.

holds.raw: וידוע דר' חמא ב"ג היה תלמיד רב ורב מניומי ב"ח אמר בשמו ואיך יהיה ר' מניומי בזמן רב
holds.reason: The transmission in Menaḥot and the fuller Ḥama article support the chain behind Heilprin’s chronology argument. That chain alone does not settle contemporaneity.
